title: HatchBoundaryInput
description: JSON Schema mirror of Models/HatchBoundaryInput.cs — the contract for da/params.json. Regenerate by hand if the record changes.

ProcessAllHatches.description: When true (the default), every HATCH entity found in the drawing's layouts is processed — the DA equivalent of "just pick them all" rather than a filtered pick.

HatchHandles.description: Optional explicit selection. Only consulted when ProcessAllHatches is false. Each entry is an AutoCAD entity Handle, e.g. the hex string produced by Entity.Handle.ToString().
